BJP Accuses Punjab CM Mann and Wife of Bribery Allegations

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has accused Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann and his wife of seeking bribes amounting to up to Rs 5 crore to settle rape cases. The allegations were made by the BJP, which also claimed that Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal was running a 'syndicate' with Mann. The specific details of the alleged settlement or the individuals involved in the purported rape cases were not provided in the coverage.
